A suspension hook and pricker are connected to the arm behind the shield. [MOBB [OPS move] 12/5/2017]

Brass hanging lamp shaped like a teapot. Circular lamp with two curved projecting wick nozzles, each ending with pointed oval lips around the circular wick hole. Pedestal foot with repeating lozenge and dot decoration. This patterning is repeated twice on the lid, which is attached via a chain (along with a pair of tweezers and a curved, bifurcated pricker) to the top of the curved arm. The arm ends with a vertical, circular domed boss. Suspension hook attached behind the boss. [MOBB [OPS move] 12/5/2017]

Hanging lamp of tinned iron. Double lamp with open, oval pans and narrow projecting nozzles. Curved arms project from the back of the pans, one with an oblong aperture, one with a nail driven through the back. Both arms end in rectangular plates with five perforations. The taller arm, which connects to the bottom pan, has an iron hook and spike attached via a swivel loop to the arm behind the plate. [MOBB [OPS move] 22/5/2017]
